variants.label: Audio
variants.tooltip: Plays audio tracks supported by the browser.

source.description: The source URL of the media file.

play.description: The play state of the media file. Toggling the property will start or pause the media file.

loop.description: Determines if the media file should loop when the end is reached.

volume.description: The percentage of maximum volume in use (from 0 to 100).

playbackRate.description: A double that represents the playback rate of the media file.

display.description: The visible state of the component.

allowDownload.description: Determines if the audio player allows downloading of the media file.

events.name: onPlay
events.description: This event is fired when playback has begun.

events.name: onPause
events.description: This event is fired when playback has been paused.

events.name: onError
events.description: This event is fired when there is an error attempting to playback.

errorMessage.description: Error message when attempting to play media file.

events.name: onEnded
events.description: This event is fired when playback has ended due to reaching end of media.

events.name: onLoaded
events.description: This event is fired when the first frame of the media has loaded.

events.name: onRateChanged
events.description: This event is fired when the playback rate of the media has changed.
